  library(glue)

})

source(here("Code/process_pisa.R"))

11 Saving subset data (rda data files)

OECD_countries = c(
  "AUS", "AUT", "BEL", "CAN", "CHL",
  "COL", "CZE", "DNK", "EST", "FIN",
  "FRA", "DEU", "GRC", "HUN", "ISL",
  "IRL", "ISR", "ITA", "JPN", "KOR",
  "LVA", "LTU", "LUX", "MEX", "NLD",
  "NZL", "NOR", "POL", "PRT", "SVK",
  "SVN", "ESP", "SWE", "CHE", "TUR",
  "GBR", "USA", "CRI")

stopifnot(nrow(OECD_countries) == 38)


sampling_student_data = function(full_data){
  set.seed(2024)
  
  subset_data <- full_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(country %in% OECD_countries) |>
    dplyr::group_by(country) %>%
    dplyr::sample_n(size = 50) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
  
  return(subset_data)
}
subset_data_transfer_folder = "Data/Output/Transfer/data"
dir.create(here(subset_data_transfer_folder), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

12 Creating heatmap for README

# Summarize missingness for each column by year
missing_summary <- all_student_data %>%
  group_by(year) %>%                                  
  summarize(across(everything(),                   
                   ~ sum(is.na(.)) / n(),          
                   .names = "missing_{col}")) %>%  
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("missing_"),
               names_to = "column", 
               values_to = "missing_percentage") %>%
  mutate(column = str_remove(column, "missing_"),
         label_missing_percentage = scales::percent(missing_percentage, accuracy = 0.1)) 

# View the summary
missing_summary
## # A tibble: 168 × 4
##     year column      missing_percentage label_missing_percentage
##    <int> <chr>                    <dbl> <chr>                   
##  1  2000 country                0       0.0%                    
##  2  2000 school_id              0       0.0%                    
##  3  2000 student_id             0       0.0%                    
##  4  2000 mother_educ            1       100.0%                  
##  5  2000 father_educ            1       100.0%                  
##  6  2000 gender                 0.00711 0.7%                    
##  7  2000 computer               1       100.0%                  
##  8  2000 internet               0.0316  3.2%                    
##  9  2000 math                   0.443   44.3%                   
## 10  2000 read                   0       0.0%                    
## # ℹ 158 more rows
p = missing_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(year), 
             y = column, 
             label = label_missing_percentage,
             fill = missing_percentage)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "white", 
    high = "#287afc",
    breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1),
    labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = c(2000, 2003, 2006, 2009, 2012, 2015, 2018, 2022)) +
  labs(title = "Missingness Percentage in the Student Data by Variables and Year",
       x = "Year",
       y = "Variables", 
       fill = "Missing Percentage") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(p)

ggsave(plot = p, 
       filename = here("Data/Output/Transfer/README_student_data_missing_values_summary.png"), height = 6, width = 12)
